QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_15

question.text: Through which platform can an investor use a single account number to transact across multiple AMCs?

answer.text: MF Utilities (MFU) using Common Account Number (CAN)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, MF Utilities (MFU) is a transaction aggregating platform that allots a Common Account Number (CAN) to investors. Investors can consolidate their mutual fund holdings under the CAN and transact in multiple schemes across participating mutual funds using a single form. The Trap: Regulatory websites such as those of SEBI, RBI or the Income Tax Department are not mutual fund transaction platforms. Note: MFU's value proposition is consolidation across participating AMCs and the use of a single form for multi-scheme transactions.
